ValidationRule.description: An approved amount is required once the application is approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Conditionally Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Booked")), OR(ISBLANK(Approved_Amount__c), Approved_Amount__c <= 0))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter an Approved Amount greater than zero.
